args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, violating FIN-212 which requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

## Changes
- Switched rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `test_half_even`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
